personalised_message_strategy.explanation: Use shortlisting criteria to select the strongest message angle, and use customer profile information to adjust tone, channel, timing, language, and offer framing.
personalised_message_strategy.why_not: Criteria-only messaging may be relevant but can feel generic. Customer context improves recognition, trust, timing, and response rate.

message_personalisation_layers.usage: Use for greeting, channel selection, and optional regional/festive context.
message_personalisation_layers.example: Hi Neha, your pre-approved loan offer is ready to view.

message_personalisation_layers.usage: Use to make the message feel relationship-led rather than cold-sales-led.
message_personalisation_layers.example: As a valued customer, you may be eligible for a faster personal loan journey.

message_personalisation_layers.usage: Use for concrete offer framing when available.
message_personalisation_layers.example: You may be eligible for a pre-approved personal loan of up to ₹8,50,000.

message_personalisation_layers.usage: Use when the customer has directly shown loan interest.
message_personalisation_layers.example: You can continue your personal loan request in just a few steps.

message_personalisation_layers.usage: Use only internally to select message angle. Do not mention the trigger directly.
message_personalisation_layers.example: Use a general liquidity-support message, not transaction-specific wording.

tone_selection_rules.sample_opening: Dear {{first_name}}, based on your banking relationship with us, you may be eligible for a pre-approved personal loan.

best_for: Customers with branch or call-center inquiry
tone_selection_rules.sample_opening: Hi {{first_name}}, I can help you complete your personal loan request quickly.
{{first_name}}, your pre-approved loan offer is ready. Check EMI options in minutes.
Dear {{first_name}}, an exclusive pre-approved personal loan offer is available for you.
This festive season, make your plans easier with a pre-approved personal loan offer.
Hi {{first_name}}, now may be a good time to plan your next purchase with flexible EMI options.

timing_rules.reason: Customer may feel more financially confident immediately after salary credit.
Intent is fresh and the customer may need assistance.
Festive periods often involve planned purchases and family expenses.
Useful for customers with recurring short-term liquidity needs, but message must remain generic.

timing_rules.trigger: customer active on app during weekends
timing_rules.recommended_time: Saturday morning or Sunday early evening
timing_rules.reason: Customers may have more time to review offers outside work hours.

message_templates.message: Hi {{first_name}}, your personal loan request is almost complete. You may be eligible for up to ₹{{pre_approved_amount}} with flexible EMI options. I can help you finish it in a few quick steps.
{{first_name}}, explore personal loan EMI options based on your preferred amount and tenure. Your pre-approved offer is ready to view.
Hi {{first_name}}, following your recent loan enquiry, I can help you check your available personal loan options and EMI choices. Would you like me to share the details?

Dear {{first_name}}, based on your relationship with us, you may be eligible for a pre-approved personal loan of up to ₹{{pre_approved_amount}}. You can use it for planned expenses with flexible repayment options.

message_templates.subject_or_header: Personal loan options after your current loan
message_templates.message: Dear {{first_name}}, as your existing loan is nearing completion, you may be eligible for fresh personal loan options with flexible tenure and EMI choices. I can help you review what suits your plans.
Hi {{first_name}}, plan your next big purchase with confidence. Your pre-approved personal loan offer is available with flexible EMI options.
Hi {{first_name}}, whether you are planning education, family, or other important expenses, you may be eligible for a personal loan with flexible repayment options.
message_templates.sensitivity_note: Do not mention a specific education transaction unless the customer explicitly raised it.

message_templates.message: Hi {{first_name}}, planning upgrades or large purchases? Your pre-approved personal loan offer can help you manage expenses with convenient EMI options.

message_templates.subject_or_header: Liquidity support without disturbing long-term plans
message_templates.message: Dear {{first_name}}, you may be eligible for a personal loan that can support short-term needs while helping you keep your long-term financial plans on track.
message_templates.sensitivity_note: Do not mention FD closure or mutual fund redemption directly.

message_templates.subject_or_header: Support for planned or unexpected expenses
message_templates.message: Dear {{first_name}}, you may be eligible for a personal loan to manage planned or unexpected expenses with structured EMI options. I can help you review the available choices.
message_templates.sensitivity_note: Never mention medical, hospital, pharmacy, low balance, or distress-related observations.

message_templates.message: Hi {{first_name}}, this Diwali, make your festive plans easier with a pre-approved personal loan offer and flexible EMI options.

message_templates.subject_or_header: Add more colour to your plans
message_templates.message: Hi {{first_name}}, this Holi, bring your plans to life with a pre-approved personal loan offer and convenient repayment options.

message_templates.subject_or_header: Start the year with flexible financial options
message_templates.message: Hi {{first_name}}, start the new year with more flexibility. Your personal loan offer is available to support planned expenses with easy EMI choices.

message_templates.subject_or_header: Personal loan offer curated for you
message_templates.message: Dear {{first_name}}, as a valued {{customer_segment}} customer, you may be eligible for an exclusive personal loan offer of up to ₹{{pre_approved_amount}}. I would be happy to help you review the best tenure and EMI options.
{{first_name}}, bigger plans need flexible options. Check your pre-approved personal loan and EMI choices in minutes.
message_templates.note: Prefer app behavior and channel preference over age alone.

scenario_selection_priority.reason: Direct intent is the strongest message anchor.
Assisted-channel intent should receive fast human follow-up.
Customer is evaluating affordability and can be nudged with EMI options.
Concrete amount and faster processing improve message clarity.
Customer may soon have repayment capacity available.
Useful when no stronger direct-intent signal exists.

message_safety_rules.rule: Do not reveal sensitive inferred triggers
examples_to_avoid: Your balance has been low before salary.
You recently redeemed your mutual fund.
Your credit card usage has spiked.
message_safety_rules.safe_alternative: You may be eligible for flexible funds to manage planned or unexpected expenses.

examples_to_avoid: As a startup employee, you may need funds...
Since you spent at a jewellery store...
message_safety_rules.safe_alternative: Based on your relationship with us, your offer is ready to view.

message_safety_rules.rule: Always include a clear opt-out or low-pressure CTA where required

message_safety_rules.max_length_guidance: Prefer 160-250 characters for SMS and 250-450 characters for WhatsApp.

message_safety_rules.rule: Use stronger personalization only for higher-trust channels
message_safety_rules.guidance: Phone and RM email can carry more detail. Push notifications should be short and generic.
